name: When should structural engineering coordination begin in a project timeline?

mainEntity.name: When should structural engineering coordination begin in a project timeline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Structural engineering coordination should ideally begin early in the design phase, immediately after the initial architectural plans are developed. Engaging a structural engineer at this stage allows for proactive identification and resolution of potential conflicts with other disciplines, before designs are finalized. This preparation ensures a more efficient workflow and reduces the likelihood of significant changes later in the project, saving time and resources.
acceptedAnswer.description: Coordination should begin early in the design phase, right after initial architectural plans are ready, to proactively resolve conflicts.
